reviews.reasoning: 10 pixels belongs only to the Finland forestry exercise. Absolute component interpretation and overlay sign-off are authored, not general cartographic accuracy.
Full-layer validation and rule meaning are supported. Boundary correction remains qualified review, not automatic deletion or cadastral certification.
Outside limits and nonrandom patterns both matter. Do not widen limits to hide a signal. Finite-window absence of signals is not proof of stability or product conformance.
The source supports stability before centering/reducing variation and proposes experiments/calibration/reanalysis. Targets, sampling and verification windows remain required professional inputs.
Source supports team planning, non-mechanical measures, monitoring and adjustment. No collection-independent RH/temperature prescription; continuous monitoring must continue.
Source explicitly supports before/after monitoring and reducing exposure. Preserve collection-specific criteria; exclude installations, electrical work and object handling.

The source supports creation then verification, not automatic retry. Plain-format WAL-capable verification and version compatibility are required by this profile; verification does not replace test restores.

High-risk in-place rewrite is explicitly documented. Include only as an offline configuration-to-verification specification, never corruption repair. Disabled state, clean shutdown, protected backup, replication coordination and approval must be established externally; existing failures stop/escalate.

The command and identify checks are documented. WEBP, dimensions, quality 85 and new filenames are profile inputs/example choices, not universal quality guarantees. Untrusted inputs require an external sandbox/resource policy.

Explicit RMSE avoids contradictory default-metric prose/table. The normalized all-channel example supports measurement; no universal threshold, monotonic quality guarantee or exit-code semantics is inferred.

Draft Easy Checks provide screening, not normative conformance. Semantic adequacy requires human judgment; distinctiveness holds only for the declared compared pages. No bookmark code is retained/executed.

Draft screening questions are supported. Starting-H1/no-skipped-subheading criteria are this profile, not universal WCAG violations. Reload/repetition/editing and human semantic acceptance are authored.

scope: Independent source-context review for specification inclusion only, not domain certification. All operations/retests/exits/bounds are authored; initial tests are source-grounded paraphrases. No added gestalts; provenance and exit_predicate are existing domain-neutral protected terms.
